headline: Asian stocks drop following tech decline led by Alphabet revenue shortfall
summary: Asian equity markets closed lower on Friday, tracking overnight losses on Wall Street. The decline was led by tech stocks following investor disappointment with cloud provider Alphabet's revenue.
why: Alphabet is one of the world's largest tech hyperscalers. Disappointing quarterly figures from megacap AI infrastructure leaders often trigger global tech sector re-evaluations.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: Frustration over lower-than-expected revenue led investors to reduce exposure to the tech giant.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Weaker cloud revenue from tech giant Alphabet triggered profit-taking in technology shares across Asian trading venues.
